verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks (webhooks or event hooks) that fire on user lifecycle or auth events. Diagnostic settings that route activity logs to endpoints are a log-export feature, and lifecycle workflows are internal automations; neither is a webhook subscription a programmatic consumer can register and receive. Identity event subscriptions are a fair axis for an identity platform, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time
